Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

Of the three, the PunkHash isn't buyable right now — no units released yet, and it's a 1.45 kW machine that needs its own circuit, so at 24¢ it'd run about $250 a month.

The real choice is the Thor P2 versus the BS-4. Same BM1373 chips: the P2 is $369, 10 TH/s, ~166 W, about $29 a month at your rate. The BS-4 is $599.99, 18 TH/s, ~300 W, about $52 a month — water cooled and more hashrate per dollar.
